0.0: That walking pair of Bermuda shorts, Little Richie, has asked me for another in a long line of inane favors.\r\n#L0##bHey, that happened to me too.#l\n#k
0.1: Did it? Then welcome to Gold Beach. You will be entirely unsurprised to find out that the two future fur hats he walks around with are just as useless as the ascot-wearing troll they follow. Will you help me?

yes.0: He lost their ball. Again. And, since our illustrious owner decided to park his resort on land infested by disgustingly playful creatures, one of the #b#o3401008##k in #m120041600# probably took it. I would greatly enjoy it if you would take some of my frustration out on them while you search.

no.0: I wouldn't help me either. I would just watch this place crumble into the sand...

1.0: Please tell me you hurt a lot of #o3401008# monsters and found that #t4033622#?

yes.0: Another pointless diversion complete. Now if we could just figure out where that submarine went, we might have something to talk about.
